items.question: What is KPKT account management?
items.answer: KPKT account management is an ongoing compliance service for licensed money lenders in Malaysia. Truestack handles licence renewals, annual submissions, company updates, and coordination with CoSec, SSM, and regulators — so your team can focus on lending instead of paperwork.

items.question: Who is this service for?
items.answer: It is for KPKT-licensed money lenders who need reliable day-to-day regulatory support. Whether you run a traditional branch operation or a digital licence, we keep renewals, filings, and company changes on track.

items.question: How much faster are approvals with Truestack?
items.answer: Operators typically see up to about 50% faster turnaround on common KPKT submissions compared with handling everything in-house. Exact timing still depends on document readiness and regulator scheduling.

items.question: Do you handle pembaharuan lesen PPW / KK and permit iklan?
items.answer: Yes. Truestack handles pembaharuan lesen PPW / KK and permit iklan (advertisement permit) renewals, plus company updates, annual submissions, and coordination with CoSec and SSM. Digital KPKT licence conversion is a separate engagement — see our Digital License service if you are going nationwide online.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: You can work with us on-demand or on a monthly or annual subscription. Annual subscribers typically save on per-request fees. There is no long-term lock-in — switch tiers as your compliance volume changes.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: Book a free consultation at truestack.my/contact. We will map your current licence status, upcoming renewals, and filing calendar, then recommend the right support plan for your lending operation.
